EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
L.D. B. 21/ 78 (xiv).THE UNIVERSITIES ACT, No. 16 OF 1978

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by subsection (4) (b) of Section 20 of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978,I, Sarath Amunugama, Minister of Higher Education and Research, on being satisfied that the administration of the affairsof the Gampaha Wickramarachchi Aryuveda Institute, Sri Lanka have been seriously dislocated and that the authorities ofthe Gampaha Wickramarachchi Aryuveda Institute have failed to restore normal conditions, do by this Order appointProfessor Jayantha Welihinda to be the Competent Authority with effect from May 25, 2015, for the purpose of exercising,performing or discharging in lieu of Director of Gampaha Wickramarachchi Aryuveda Institute any powers, duties andfunctions respectively which have been conferred or imposed on, or assigned to the said Director of the GampahaWickramarachchi Aryuveda Institute, Sri Lanka, under the said Act, or any Order, Ordinance, Statute, by law, Regulation orRule made thereunder.
SARATH AMUNUGAMA,Minister of Higher Education and Research.
